description: Solo founder persona pack: three subagent consultants - idea-validator (hypothesis validation before code: JTBD/discovery/competitors/moat/pre-mortem), mvp-scoper (narrowing to MVP, roadmap, brd→prd) and founder-cadence (weekly rhythm + decision-log, monetization/unit-economics). Role pack: not tied to the stack, not auto-detected - selected explicitly and installed with any stack pack (PACK_PREFIX matches).

interview.q: Project agent name prefix (like a stack pack)?

notes.prerequisite: Persona pack: placed on top of any stack pack. {PACK_PREFIX} must match the stackpack prefix in order for @<prefix>-<role> resolved to play his role (for example, founder-cadence takes the technical stens into @<prefix>-startup-cto / stack roles).
notes.verify_workflow: These are subagents (.md), not a work flow - node --check does not apply.
